description: NaNd₉(Ge₃O₁₃)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.67 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are five inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.84 Å. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.86 Å. In the third Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.93 Å. In the fourth Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.86 Å. In the fifth Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.71 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.78 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.79 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Nd atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent Nd atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Nd, and one Ge atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Nd and one Ge atom to form distorted ONd₃Ge tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaNd₂Ge tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONd₃Ge tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Nd and one Ge atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Nd and one Ge atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Nd and one Ge atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Nd and one Ge atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Nd and one Ge atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Nd, and one Ge atom to form distorted ONaNd₂Ge tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONd₃Ge tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent ONaNd₂Ge tetrahedra.
